description: This file defines the ColumnLikeGridlinesRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering gridlines on chart axes (X and Y) for column or line charts within a PDF processing library. It contains methods to draw gridlines based on axis scales and formatting, leveraging a graphics context and transformation matrices.

classes.name: ColumnLikeGridlinesRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that draws gridlines for column or line charts in a PDF charting context, handling both major and minor gridlines for X and Y axes.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws gridlines on the chart by calculating positions based on axis scales and formatting, transforming points via a matrix, and rendering lines for major and minor ticks on both axes.
